findings.reason: The clipped chord and real trace maximization yield the exact V identity, including kappa*T and the finite quadratic budget correction. The real q body is used only as an upper comparison.

E0 coercivity bounds c for every potentially profitable state. Its relative error remains O(c/m), so arbitrarily small c>0 is excluded uniformly. C0 squeezes profit to zero and C4 then gives l1/c proximity to the full critical set. The empty branch is excluded by c>1/4. Sequential contradiction gives a single large-m bound over the whole band.

Original all-unitary necessity gives each fully assigned witness PSD. Positive kappa makes aI-P positive definite. Its nonnegative resolvent walks retain every primary-edge walk plus exactly 2*tau/a^2 in the first remaining walk, including overlap and all growing slots. The implicit cost function is strictly increasing and has uniformly bounded derivative, yielding c-c0>=1.6*tau.

C4 first makes every other head at most eta. Exact subtraction then charges its squared gain by eta*tau while the protection budget costs at least 0.24*0.9*1.6*tau. Since eta+kappa<=0.02 eventually, V<=V0-tau/4 has a strict uniform margin. No additive error independent of tau appears.

findings.reason: The scalar loss formula and one sign change restrict winning ranks to floor/ceil.
